name: Washimi Kiyoto
source: A third-year at Ichijyoukan High School. He is part of three idiots' group who are also [url=/c43026]Yuri's[/url] henchmen. Calls Yuri "Hime", and started doing Stride after Yuri saved him from an accident in a convenience store. Kiyoto's hobbies include checking convenience store's meals.
